title: Mary M NDE 4725
content: I had just given birth to my first son. I had been diagnosed with toxemia. I was in a bed in a hospital room. Two orderlies came in and tried to get me out of bed to empty my bladder. I said I could not get up so they lifted me out of the bed and put me on my feet. I immediately fell to the floor. I left my body and floated to the ceiling. I could see the orderlies and a nurse around me. They were saying no blood pressure, no pulse - all the while, I thought this was hilarious. Then I thought I must be dead, I am still thinking, I am laughing without a body, I am still here!!! Then I was in a black place of no light, a void. I was concerned but not scared. Then I felt a rushing feeling and into the brightest most beautiful, loving light. Words cannot describe the love I felt. I said I want to stay here forever. I felt several presences in front of me, but I all I saw was light - I was the light. They said, 'You cannot stay here.' I said, 'Please, please, I don't want to return.' They said, 'You have a child.' I said, 'My mom will take care of him and so will his father!' They said, 'He needs you!!!' At that moment I was being pulled, like being sucked into a vacuum, and bam!! I was in my body again! When I got close to my body, I heard the nurse say, 'Get the EPI.' I slammed into my body with a great sinking feeling! I was sad and depressed for several days. My life changed on that day forever. I no longer fear death. I strive to do what is right by GOD! When I was in the place of light, I felt all of the negative parts of me float away. I did not care about leaving my new son or my life behind. Everything of this world just fell away from me. The only thing left was pure JOY!! The real me. I feel I must tell everyone that there is no death - only pure JOY and life!!

tunnel.movement_other_detail: Described a 'rushing feeling' and later being pulled 'like being sucked into a vacuum.'

arrival.other_being_detail: Felt 'several presences' in front of her but only saw light.

environment.environment_other_detail: Also described an initial 'black place of no light, a void.'

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Postpartum complication with toxemia; collapsed when orderlies lifted her to stand.

stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in hospital room, then a dark void, then rushing/pulled into a bright loving light with presences and dialogue, then forced return to body.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: During the OBE, she found it 'hilarious' that staff reported 'no blood pressure, no pulse' and she was 'laughing without a body.' She also described feeling 'all of the negative parts of me float away' in the light.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “no blood pressure, no pulse” / “I am laughing without a body, I am still here!!!” / “Words cannot describe the love I felt.” / “You cannot stay here.” / “He needs you!!!” / “slammed into my body with a great sinking feeling!” / “there is no death - only pure JOY and life!!”
